title: When the Confession Falls
author: P. M. Voss
blurb: Ulyana Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
